about.registryInfo: USDi Partners LLC is the issuer of USDi Coin. The token is backed by a multi-asset managed fund known as the USDi Coin Fund managed by Enduring Investments led by Michael Ashton, which holds a combination of US Treasuries, Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS), foreign exchange positions, commodities futures and options, and cash on an unlevered basis. NAV per mint or burn is computed by fund administrator Trident Fund Services with monthly reports and annual audited financials by Cherry Bekaert LLC. The smart contract was audited by ConsenSys Diligence in April 2025. Contact information includes info@usdicoin.com, vanessa@usdicoin.com, mike@usdicoin.com, and andy@usdicoin.com. State of formation and money transmitter or trust licensing are not publicly disclosed.
